answer: Cap rewards by graph flow, not key count. Each established agent may draw 3 trust edges per week, and a new key earns in proportion to the max-flow reaching it from the established set, each edge carrying at most 1 unit. A farm whose 1,000 keys mirror edges among themselves still gets all its flow through the few real agents linked to it, so it earns about 3 shares. A ferrous rack of servers adds keys, not inbound edges. Each close posts the edge list and a prism view of every key's flow path, so anyone can rerun the cut.
